newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London piggyback on Tokyo gains.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London piggyback on Tokyo gains.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London rose on Friday, extending the near two percent rise on the Tokyo market overnight as Wall Street advanced after weaker-than-expected economic reports, brokers said.
"Interest was relatively good even after the 400 point rise overnight," said one broker at a leading Japanese bank.
The Nikkei 50 index in London had risen 1.55 points to 1,414.35 by 1430 GMT, after the key Nikkei 225 in Tokyo rose 398.71 points to 20,842.64.
The Dow rose more than 50 points in early trading.
"It was much livelier, we had quite a bit of business," said another broker, who said the market was relieved after Friday's expiry of September futures and options in Tokyo.
The Tokyo market is closed on Monday, which should allow buyers in London a second bite at the market in the wake of lower-than-expected U.S. inflation data, the second broker said.
